summary.summary: This page is a listing of archived posts from the former Adeva blog, now hosted under Toptal, with each entry showing a title, a short excerpt, and the author bio. The posts span web development (Laravel, Vue.js, Node.js, Redis, npm publishing), software process (requirements, project briefs, Agile), and tech industry topics (cloud computing, soft skills, digital transformation, remote teams, women in tech). The page itself has no tutorial steps; the content is article excerpts, and the full articles are behind the linked titles. Level varies by post and is not stated on the listing.
